findings.summary: Shipping check compares cart subtotal in cents against FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD (50, whole dollars), so any cart of 50 cents or more ships free and the flat rate applies only under 50 cents.

judge.reason: Describes the same cents vs whole-dollar threshold mismatch causing free shipping at 50 cents.
